basic_details.job_title: IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Laboratory Attendant, Assistant Project Engin Posts
basic_details.organization_name: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IIT Guwahati)
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IIT Guwahati) has officially released the Project Scientist, Assistant Project Engineer and More Recruitment 2026 notification (Advt. No. IITG/II&SI/Project Staff Rectt-2026/130) for 4 vacancies at IIT Guwahati, Assam. Eligible candidates with a Ph.D. degree, Master's degree in Science/Humanities with six years of experience, Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Design, or High School qualification with one year of relevant experience (as applicable to the respective post) can apply online up to 06 August 2026 through the official website, https://www.iitg.

qualification.education_qualification: PhD degree Or Master's degree in Science/Humanities + 6 yrs exp., Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Design, High School pass with 1 yr exp.
qualification.details: Project Scientist: PhD degree Or Master's degree in Science/Humanities + 6 yrs exp. Assistant Project Engineer: Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Design Laboratory Attendant: High School pass with 1 yr exp.

salary_details.details: Project Scientist: Rs. 50000/- + 20% HRA Assistant Project Engineer: Rs. 30000/- + 20% HRA Laboratory Attendant: Rs. 10000/- + 20% HRA

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 06-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the IIT Guwahati Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download IIT Guwahati Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 4 vacancies are available – 2 for Project Scientist, 1 for Assistant Project Engineer, and 1 for Laboratory Attendant.

content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Scientist: PhD degree Or Master's degree in Science/Humanities + 6 yrs exp. Assistant Project Engineer: Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Design Laboratory Attendant: High School pass with 1 yr exp.

content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Project Scientist: Rs. 50000/- + 20% HRA Assistant Project Engineer: Rs. 30000/- + 20% HRA Laboratory Attendant: Rs. 10000/- + 20% HRA

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 06-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Guwahati recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IIT Guwahati recruitment is 06-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Scientist posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for Project Scientist and related posts at IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply for this recruitment through the Online mode.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Project Scientist position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Scientist position is Rs. 50000/- + 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Laboratory Attendant post?
faq.answer: For the Laboratory Attendant post, a High School pass with 1 year of experience is required.

faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in this recruitment.

faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will be based on an Interview.

faq.answer: The official notification link is provided in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.answer: The walk-in interview date is scheduled for 10-08-2026.
